title.zh-CN: 误服药物后腹痛、肌肉震颤 · 9岁男孩
title.en: Abdominal pain and muscle twitching after a medication error · 9-year-old boy

summary.zh-CN: 9岁男孩，家里给他服药后约20分钟开始腹痛、出汗、肌肉抖动，从外院转来急诊。
summary.en: A 9-year-old boy whose abdominal pain, sweating and muscle twitching began about 20 minutes after his family gave him a medicine is transferred to the emergency department.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 根据片剂规格和片数算出实际服药量（15 × 15 mg = 225 mg，6.25 mg/kg），并与医嘱剂量（四分之一片，3.75 mg）比较，说出差错的倍数（60倍）。
learningOutcomes.en: Work out the dose taken from the tablet strength and count (15 × 15 mg = 225 mg; 6.25 mg/kg), compare it with the intended quarter tablet (3.75 mg) and state the size of the error (60-fold).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 根据毒蕈碱样和烟碱样表现识别新斯的明（氨基甲酸酯类胆碱酯酶抑制剂）过量引起的胆碱能危象，并说明瞳孔4 mm、心率72次/分为什么不能排除。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise a cholinergic crisis from a neostigmine (carbamate cholinesterase inhibitor) overdose by its muscarinic and nicotinic signs, and explain why 4-mm pupils and a heart rate of 72/min do not exclude it.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 安排第一个小时：持续心肺监护、静脉阿托品按体征滴定（美国FDA新斯的明说明书，2015年修订）、联系中毒咨询；服药4小时后不再做胃肠道去污（AACT/EAPCCT 2013、2005）。
learningOutcomes.en: Plan the first hour: continuous cardiorespiratory monitoring, IV atropine titrated to the signs (FDA neostigmine prescribing information, revised 2015), poisons-service advice, and no further gut decontamination four hours after the tablets (AACT/EAPCCT 2013, 2005).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 解读胆碱酯酶1790 U/L、窦性心律和血钠126.7 mmol/L各自能说明和不能说明什么，并据此行动：等张维持液（AAP 2018）；若需插管，避免琥珀胆碱。
learningOutcomes.en: Interpret a cholinesterase of 1790 U/L, sinus rhythm and a sodium of 126.7 mmol/L for what each can and cannot show, and act on them: isotonic maintenance fluid (AAP 2018) and no suxamethonium if he needs intubation.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 把入院约两小时心率降到47次/分识别为毒蕈碱样作用，在持续监护下重复、滴定阿托品（AHA/AAP 2025 PALS：迷走张力增高引起的心动过缓用阿托品），灌注不良时准备好氧合、通气和心肺复苏。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise the fall in heart rate to 47/min about two hours after admission as a muscarinic effect, and treat it with repeated, titrated atropine under continuous monitoring (AHA/AAP 2025 PALS: atropine for bradycardia from increased vagal tone), with oxygenation, ventilation and CPR ready if perfusion fails.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 出院前切断差错链：停药并追问用药指征，上报并坦诚告知差错，用回授法核实以毫克和片数写明的用法（AHRQ 2024）。
learningOutcomes.en: Close the error chain before discharge: stop the drug and question its indication, report and disclose the error, and confirm dose instructions written in mg and in tablets by teach-back (AHRQ 2024).

notes.zh-CN: 依据单篇已发表病例报告改编。本版（1.1.0）的患者事实全部沿用1.0.0版从报告中提取的内容——9岁3个月男孩，体重36 kg；因发热、咳嗽两天就诊，就诊时流泪、畏光、不愿睁眼，除抗感染治疗外被开了新斯的明；药片每片15 mg，每次四分之一片的医嘱被家长当成四分之一瓶，实际给了15片；约20分钟后腹痛、出汗、流涎、呕吐，四肢肌肉和下颌抖动；服药后没有抽搐、昏迷、皮疹或腹泻；当地洗胃后转院，服药约四小时入院；入院时清醒但萎靡、皮肤潮湿、不能自行站立、四肢肌肉震颤，瞳孔4 mm、对光反射敏捷（1.0.0英文作“reactive”），心率72次/分，肠鸣音增强；胆碱酯酶1790 U/L（参考5000–12000），钠126.7 mmol/L，钾3.79 mmol/L，心电图窦性心律；入院约两小时心率最低47次/分，仍腹痛、皮肤潮湿；此后在拮抗和监测治疗下症状改善、胆碱酯酶逐渐上升；用阿托品并持续监测，症状逐渐消退，第5天停药，第6天出院，出院后5天无不适、胆碱酯酶正常——尚未对照原文全文核对。患者为化名，医院和日历日期已去除，时间以相对时间表示。分阶段（包括检验结果在下一阶段回报）、决策、处置选项、评分、医护角色、家长在场以及家长说出的担忧均为教学设计，不增加临床事实；未记录的内容（血压、呼吸、血氧、体温、肺部体征、开药理由、洗胃的时间和液体、阿托品的剂量和时间、第5天停的是什么等）保持未知。本例没有获准展示的原文图片。
notes.en: Adapted from a single published case report. Every patient fact in this version (1.1.0) is one extracted from the report for version 1.0.0 — a boy of 9 years 3 months weighing 36 kg; two days of fever and cough, with tearing, photophobia and reluctance to open the eyes at the clinic, where neostigmine was prescribed alongside anti-infective treatment; 15 mg tablets, a dose of a quarter of a tablet each time that the parent took to mean a quarter of the bottle, so that 15 tablets were given; abdominal pain, sweating, salivation, vomiting and twitching of the limbs and jaw about 20 minutes later; no seizure, coma, rash or diarrhoea after the tablets; gastric lavage locally, transfer and admission about four hours after the tablets; on admission alert but lethargic, moist skin, unable to stand unaided, limb twitching, pupils 4 mm reacting briskly to light (1.0.0's English says 'reactive'), heart rate 72/min and increased bowel sounds; cholinesterase 1790 U/L (reference 5000–12000), sodium 126.7 mmol/L, potassium 3.79 mmol/L and sinus rhythm on the ECG; a heart rate at its lowest 47/min about two hours after admission with continuing abdominal pain and moist skin; improvement under antagonist treatment and monitoring with a gradually rising cholinesterase; atropine and continuous monitoring with gradual resolution, treatment stopped on day 5, discharge on day 6, and no complaints with a normal cholinesterase five days after discharge — and none has yet been checked against the full article. The patient has a pseudonym; hospitals and calendar dates are removed and time is relative. The phases (including the results coming back in the next phase), decisions, intervention options, scoring, staff, the parent's presence and the parent's voiced worries are teaching design and add no clinical fact; what is not recorded (blood pressure, breathing, oxygen saturation, temperature, chest findings, the reason for the prescription, the timing and fluid of the lavage, the atropine doses and timing, what exactly was stopped on day 5) stays unknown. No figure of the report is approved for display.

triageNote.zh-CN: 9岁男孩，用药剂量出错后约四小时从外院转入；腹痛、肌肉震颤。家长陪同。体重36 kg。
triageNote.en: 9-year-old boy transferred in about four hours after a dosing mistake with one of his medicines; abdominal pain and muscle twitching. A parent is with him. Weight 36 kg.

personality.zh-CN: 9岁男孩，神志清醒但精神萎靡，只说几个字；陪他来的家长着急，愿意把用药经过讲清楚。
personality.en: A 9-year-old who is awake but listless and says only a few words; the parent with him is worried and keen to explain exactly what happened with the tablets.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 孩子用很短的话说自己哪里难受；家长用日常语言讲经过，说得出药名和每片的规格。
speechStyle.en: The boy says in short phrases how he feels; his parent tells the story in everyday words and can name the medicine and the tablet strength.

openingLine.en: My tummy hurts… my arms and legs are twitching…

fallbackUnknown.en: That I can't tell you for sure, doctor.

concerns.en: Is he going to be all right?
How was that medicine supposed to be given?

actingNotes.zh-CN: 家长回答病史；直接问孩子的问题由孩子自己回答，只说肚子疼、手脚在抖这样的感受。孩子清醒但没精神，不能自己站起来。家长能讲清楚：药是新斯的明，每片15毫克，医嘱每次四分之一片，家里当成了四分之一瓶，给他吃了15片。是哪位家长喂的药、在什么地方、医嘱是写的还是口头交代的、洗胃是什么时候做的，都没有记录，不要编。病历里没有的事（来院前呼吸怎么样、过敏、以前的病、预防接种、瓶里还剩几片、现在还烧不烧、这个药是治什么的）如实说不知道。
actingNotes.en: The parent answers the history; questions put to the boy he answers himself, only with how he feels (tummy pain, arms and legs twitching). He is awake but listless and cannot stand up without help. The parent can explain the tablets plainly: neostigmine, 15 mg each, a dose of a quarter of a tablet each time that the family took to mean a quarter of the bottle, so he was given 15 tablets. Which parent gave them, where, whether the instruction was written or spoken and when the lavage was done are not known — never invent them. Anything his notes do not hold (his breathing before arrival, allergies, earlier illnesses, vaccinations, how many tablets are left, whether he is still feverish, what the medicine was for) is honestly not known.

name.zh-CN: 魏清和的家长（化名）

persona.zh-CN: 陪孩子来的家长，讲得清用药经过：医嘱每次四分之一片，家里当成了四分之一瓶，给孩子吃了15片（每片15毫克）。是父亲还是母亲、当时由谁喂药，病历没有记录。
persona.en: The parent who came with him, who can explain the dosing: a quarter of a tablet each time, which the family took to mean a quarter of the bottle, so he was given 15 tablets of 15 mg. Whether this is his mother or his father, and who gave the tablets, is not recorded.

question.zh-CN: 孩子这次怎么不舒服？多久了？
question.en: What's brought him in today, and since when?

answer.zh-CN: 他的药给错了量。吃下去以后肚子疼、肌肉发抖，到现在有四个小时了。
answer.en: He was given the wrong amount of his medicine. After he took it his tummy started hurting and his muscles started twitching — that's about four hours ago now.

en: tell me what's been going on

question.zh-CN: 吃的是什么药？吃了多少片？
question.en: Which medicine was it, and how many tablets did he get?

answer.zh-CN: 是新斯的明，一片15毫克。医嘱是每次吃四分之一片，我们把它当成了四分之一瓶，结果给他吃了15片。
answer.en: Neostigmine — 15 mg tablets. The dose was a quarter of a tablet each time, but we took it to mean a quarter of the bottle, so he was given 15 tablets.

question.zh-CN: 吃药以后多久开始不舒服？都有哪些表现？
question.en: How soon after the tablets did it start, and what happened?

answer.en: About twenty minutes later his tummy started hurting, he was sweating and drooling, he vomited, and the muscles of his arms and legs and his jaw were twitching.

answer.en: He'd had a fever and a cough for two days. At the clinic his eyes were watering, the light bothered him and he didn't want to open his eyes. Besides something for the infection, the doctor prescribed this medicine.

name.zh-CN: 持续心电、血氧和血压监护，并定时评估呼吸与肌力
name.en: Continuous ECG, SpO₂ and blood pressure monitoring, with regular checks of breathing and strength

dose.zh-CN: 床旁监护仪持续监测心电、血氧和血压；定时记录呼吸频率、分泌物、咳嗽、吞咽和坐立能力；心率下降或呼吸变弱时立即升级处理。
dose.en: Continuous ECG, oxygen saturation and blood pressure on the bedside monitor; chart the breathing rate, secretions, cough, swallowing and ability to sit or stand at regular intervals; escalate at once if the heart rate falls or breathing weakens.

response.zh-CN: 已接上监护，并定时评估呼吸和肌力。除病历中记录的心率外，监护读数没有记录。
response.en: He is on the monitor, and his breathing and strength are checked regularly. Beyond the heart rate charted, no monitor readings are recorded.

name.zh-CN: 建立静脉通路

dose.zh-CN: 外周静脉留置针；同时抽取入院血标本。
dose.en: Peripheral IV cannula; take the admission bloods at the same time.

name.zh-CN: 联系中毒咨询中心或临床毒理医师
name.en: Call the poisons information service or a clinical toxicologist

dose.zh-CN: 报告药名和规格、片数、服药时间、体重和目前体征。
dose.en: Give the drug and tablet strength, the number of tablets, the time taken, his weight and his current signs.

response.zh-CN: 毒理医师记下了情况，请你算出总剂量（毫克）和每公斤剂量，并在他的呼吸或心率有变化时随时回电。
response.en: The toxicologist takes the details, asks you to work out the total dose in mg and in mg/kg, and to call back with any change in his breathing or heart rate.

name.zh-CN: 静脉注射阿托品，按毒蕈碱样表现滴定
name.en: IV atropine, titrated to the muscarinic signs

dose.zh-CN: 阿托品50 μg/kg静脉注射（36 kg约1.8 mg；单次最大3 mg）；无效时每5分钟给予前一剂量的两倍，直至出现阿托品效应，之后按需每1–4小时重复有效剂量或更低剂量（珀斯儿童医院阿托品用药专论，2024年审核，胆碱能危象剂量）；与中毒咨询共同决定。
dose.en: Atropine 50 micrograms/kg IV (1.8 mg at 36 kg; maximum 3 mg per dose); if a dose is ineffective, give double that dose every 5 minutes until the atropine effect is evident, then repeat the effective or a lower dose every 1–4 hours as needed (Perth Children's Hospital atropine monograph, reviewed 2024, cholinergic-crisis dosing); agree the plan with the poisons service.

response.zh-CN: 已静脉注射阿托品。每次给药后复查心率、出汗、分泌物和肺部；阿托品不能逆转肌肉震颤，也不能逆转肌无力。本病例不记录每次给药后的反应，也不模拟其效果。
response.en: Atropine given IV. Reassess his heart rate, sweating, secretions and chest after each dose; atropine does not reverse the twitching or any muscle weakness. This case does not record his response to each dose and does not simulate it.

name.zh-CN: 收入有监护条件的病房（儿科HDU/PICU），请毒理会诊
name.en: Admit to a monitored bed (paediatric HDU/PICU) with toxicology input

dose.zh-CN: 收入院持续心肺监护，直到停药后胆碱能表现不再出现；备好呼吸支持的人员和设备。
dose.en: Admit for continuous cardiorespiratory monitoring until the cholinergic signs stay away off treatment, with staff and equipment ready to support his breathing.

response.zh-CN: 已安排有监护条件的床位；转运前持续监护。
response.en: A monitored bed is arranged; he stays on the monitor until he moves.

name.zh-CN: 静脉等张维持液（0.9%氯化钠加5%葡萄糖）
name.en: IV isotonic maintenance fluid (0.9% sodium chloride with 5% glucose)

dose.zh-CN: 等张晶体液（0.9%氯化钠加5%葡萄糖，按需补钾），按体重计算维持速度；复查血钠。
dose.en: Isotonic crystalloid (0.9% sodium chloride with 5% glucose, potassium as needed) at the maintenance rate for his weight; recheck the sodium.

response.zh-CN: 等张维持液已输注。没有复查血钠的记录。
response.en: Isotonic maintenance fluid is running. No repeat sodium is recorded.

name.zh-CN: 停用新斯的明，保留药品和用法说明以便核对
name.en: Stop the neostigmine and keep the medicine and its instructions for checking

dose.zh-CN: 不再服用新斯的明；请家属带来药瓶和用法说明，核对片数和剂量。
dose.en: No more neostigmine; ask the family to bring the bottle and the instructions so the tablets and the dose can be checked.

response.zh-CN: 已停用新斯的明。瓶中剩余片数没有记录。
response.en: Neostigmine stopped. How many tablets are left in the bottle is not recorded.

name.zh-CN: 上报用药差错并向家属坦诚说明
name.en: Report the medication error and explain it openly to the family

dose.zh-CN: 通过医院不良事件系统上报；通知开药医生和药房；不带指责地向家属说明发生了什么、以后如何避免。
dose.en: Report through the hospital incident system; inform the prescriber and the pharmacy; explain to the family, without blame, what went wrong and what will change.

response.zh-CN: 已上报，并向家属说明了经过。病历中没有关于上报或沟通的记录。
response.en: Reported, and the family has been told what happened. His record mentions no report or conversation.

name.zh-CN: 出院宣教并用回授法核实：每种药的剂量写明毫克数和片数
name.en: Discharge teaching checked by teach-back: every dose written in mg and in tablets

dose.zh-CN: 书面列出每种药的剂量（毫克数和片数）和频次；请家属用自己的话复述并演示怎么取药；安全存放；告知何时需要返院。
dose.en: A written plan listing each medicine with its dose in mg and in tablets and how often; the family explains it back in their own words and shows how they will measure it; safe storage; when to come back.

response.zh-CN: 已用回授法核实，发现的偏差已纠正并再次核对。病历没有记录出院时给了哪些指导。
response.en: Teach-back done; any gaps were corrected and checked again. His record does not describe the advice given at discharge.

name.zh-CN: 再次洗胃

dose.zh-CN: 经口或经鼻置胃管，反复灌洗至洗出液清亮。
dose.en: Orogastric or nasogastric tube, washing repeatedly until the return is clear.

harm.zh-CN: AACT/EAPCCT 2013年立场声明更新：洗胃不应常规进行，甚至根本不应进行；气道未受保护，或洗胃会增加误吸风险和严重程度时禁用；并发症包括吸入性肺炎、喉痉挛、心律失常以及水和电解质紊乱。他服药已约4小时，已经洗过一次胃，服药后吐过、流过口水，现在不能自行站立——再次洗胃只增加误吸和心律失常的风险，没有证据表明有益。
harm.en: AACT/EAPCCT 2013 position paper update: gastric lavage should not be performed routinely, if at all; it is contraindicated with an unprotected airway or where it increases the risk and severity of aspiration, and its complications include aspiration pneumonia, laryngospasm, arrhythmia and fluid and electrolyte imbalance. He is about 4 hours out, has had one lavage already, vomited and drooled after the tablets and cannot stand without help — a second lavage adds aspiration and arrhythmia risk with no proven benefit.

response.zh-CN: 已再次洗胃。病历中没有再次洗胃的记录，本病例不模拟其后果。
response.en: A second lavage is done. Nothing like it is in his record, and the case does not simulate what follows.

name.zh-CN: 口服或经胃管给予活性炭
name.en: Activated charcoal by mouth or nasogastric tube

dose.zh-CN: 活性炭0.5–1 g/kg，口服或经胃管（AACT/EAPCCT 2005年立场声明引用的1–12岁儿童剂量）。
dose.en: Activated charcoal 0.5–1 g/kg by mouth or tube (the dose for children aged 1–12 quoted in the AACT/EAPCCT 2005 position paper).

harm.zh-CN: AACT/EAPCCT 2005年立场声明：单剂活性炭不应常规使用；只有在摄入有潜在毒性的量后1小时内才可以考虑（1小时后的获益不能排除，但没有证据显示活性炭能改善临床结局）；除非气道完好或已受保护，否则禁用，在增加误吸风险时也禁用。服药约4小时、洗过胃、服药后吐过、不能自行站立的孩子用活性炭，增加误吸风险而预期获益很小。
harm.en: AACT/EAPCCT 2005 position paper: single-dose activated charcoal should not be given routinely; it may be considered up to 1 hour after a potentially toxic ingestion (benefit later cannot be excluded, but there is no evidence that charcoal improves clinical outcome), and it is contraindicated unless the airway is intact or protected, or where it increases aspiration risk. About 4 hours after the tablets, after a lavage, in a child who vomited after the tablets and cannot stand without help, it adds aspiration risk for little expected benefit.

response.zh-CN: 已给予活性炭。病历中没有使用活性炭的记录，本病例不模拟其效果。
response.en: Charcoal given. Nothing like it is in his record, and its effect is not simulated.

name.zh-CN: 静脉低张维持液（如1/4或1/5张含钠液）
name.en: IV hypotonic maintenance fluid (such as 0.18% sodium chloride with 4% glucose)

dose.zh-CN: 低张含钠糖液，按维持速度输注。
dose.en: A hypotonic saline–glucose solution at the maintenance rate.

harm.zh-CN: AAP 2018年儿童静脉维持液临床实践指南：28天至18岁需要维持液的患儿应使用含适量氯化钾和葡萄糖的等张液，因为等张液能显著降低发生低钠血症的风险。他吐过、出过汗、洗过胃，血钠可能已经偏低；低张维持液会让它进一步下降。
harm.en: AAP 2018 clinical practice guideline on maintenance IV fluids: patients aged 28 days to 18 years who need maintenance fluid should receive isotonic solutions with appropriate potassium chloride and dextrose, because they significantly decrease the risk of hyponatraemia. He has vomited, sweated and had a lavage, so his sodium may already be low; a hypotonic maintenance fluid can drive it lower.

response.zh-CN: 低张液已输注。没有复查血钠的记录，本病例不模拟其效果。
response.en: Hypotonic fluid running. No repeat sodium is recorded, and its effect is not simulated.

name.zh-CN: 出院回家，或转入无监护的普通病床
name.en: Discharge home, or move to an unmonitored ward bed

dose.zh-CN: 现在出院，或转入普通病床只做常规观察。
dose.en: Discharge now, or transfer to a general ward bed with routine observations only.

harm.zh-CN: 美国FDA新斯的明说明书（2015年修订）：过量时，要用人工方法支持通气直到自主呼吸确实足够，并监测心脏功能；胆碱能危象的特点是肌无力逐渐加重，累及呼吸肌时如不及时处理可致死，过量时的毒蕈碱样表现还包括心动过缓。一次心率或一份心电图不能说明危险已经过去：在停药后胆碱能表现不再出现之前，他需要持续监护。
harm.en: FDA neostigmine prescribing information (revised 2015): after an overdose, ventilation is supported by artificial means until spontaneous breathing is assured to be adequate, and cardiac function is monitored; a cholinergic crisis is marked by increasing muscle weakness that can kill through the respiratory muscles if not promptly treated, and the muscarinic effects of overdose include bradycardia. One heart rate or one ECG does not show that the danger has passed: he needs continuous monitoring until the cholinergic signs stay away off treatment.

response.zh-CN: 他被撤离了持续监护。病历中没有这样的处理，本病例不模拟其后果。
response.en: He is taken off continuous monitoring. Nothing like this is in his record, and the case does not simulate what follows.

name.zh-CN: 给予新斯的明（恢复原处方剂量，或因他站不起来而加量）
name.en: Give neostigmine (restart the prescribed dose, or more because he cannot stand)

dose.zh-CN: 新斯的明口服，按原处方每次四分之一片（15 mg片，即3.75 mg），或因他站不起来而加量。
dose.en: Neostigmine by mouth: the prescribed quarter of a 15 mg tablet (3.75 mg) per dose, or more because he cannot stand.

harm.zh-CN: 美国FDA新斯的明说明书（2015年修订）：胆碱能危象和肌无力危象可能难以区分，而在胆碱能危象时增加新斯的明或同类药物的剂量可能造成严重后果——胆碱能危象需要立即停用所有这类药物，并建议立即使用阿托品。他吃下15片约20分钟后出现肌肉抖动、出汗、流涎和呕吐，到院时不能自行站立；病历中没有重症肌无力，也没有记录这个药的用药指征。
harm.en: FDA neostigmine prescribing information (revised 2015): a cholinergic crisis can be hard to tell from a myasthenic crisis, and more neostigmine or another drug of its class in a cholinergic crisis could have grave consequences — the crisis calls for prompt withdrawal of all drugs of this type, and immediate atropine is recommended. Twitching, sweating, drooling and vomiting began about 20 minutes after 15 tablets, and on arrival he could not stand without help; no myasthenia and no reason for the drug are recorded.

response.zh-CN: 已给予新斯的明。病历中没有这样的处理，本病例不模拟其后果。
response.en: Neostigmine given. Nothing like this is in his record, and the case does not simulate what follows.

title.zh-CN: 问清吃了什么、什么时候吃的
title.en: Find out what he took and when

hint.zh-CN: 问家长：是什么药、吃了几片、吃后多久出现了什么、来之前做过什么处理。
hint.en: Ask his parent which medicine it was, how many tablets, what happened afterwards and how soon, and what was done before the transfer.

guidance.zh-CN: 家长回答病史；问孩子本人时，他自己回答。
guidance.en: His parent gives the history; questions put to the boy he answers himself.

title.zh-CN: 查体并判断发生了什么
title.en: Examine him and name what is happening

hint.zh-CN: 看皮肤、看瞳孔、看四肢肌肉，试试他能不能站起来，然后作出判断。
hint.en: Look at his skin, his pupils and his limb muscles, see whether he can stand, then decide.

guidance.zh-CN: 服药后约四小时，他转到了急诊。
guidance.en: About four hours after the tablets, he has reached the emergency department.

title.zh-CN: 保障第一个小时的安全

hint.zh-CN: 想一想：他该待在哪里、靠什么盯住他、要给什么、哪些处理只会增加风险。
hint.en: Think about where he should be, what will watch him, what you would give and what would only add risk.

hint.zh-CN: 调阅血液结果和心电图：它们能证实什么，又不能告诉你什么？
hint.en: Read the bloods and the ECG: what do they confirm, and what can they not tell you?

guidance.zh-CN: 入院时送检的结果已经回报。

title.zh-CN: 持续评估，发现变化及时处理
title.en: Keep reassessing and act on what you find

hint.zh-CN: 被叫回去时，先看气道、呼吸和循环，再作决定。
hint.en: When you are called back, check his airway, breathing and circulation first, then decide.

guidance.zh-CN: 护士请你回去再看看他。
guidance.en: The nurse asks you to come back and see him.

title.zh-CN: 安排安全出院并核对转归
title.en: Plan a safe discharge and review the outcome

hint.zh-CN: 出院前，哪些事情必须改变、由谁来改变？然后看看他这次住院是怎么结束的。
hint.en: What must change before he goes home, and who must change it? Then read how his stay ended.

prompt.zh-CN: 他神志清醒但精神萎靡，皮肤潮湿，四肢肌肉震颤，不能自行站立；瞳孔4 mm，对光反射敏捷；心率72次/分，肠鸣音增强。最好的解释是什么？
prompt.en: He is alert but lethargic, his skin is moist, his limb muscles are twitching and he cannot stand without help; his pupils are 4 mm and react briskly; his heart rate is 72/min and his bowel sounds are increased. What is the best explanation?

need.zh-CN: 先问清吃了什么药、吃后多久出现了什么，再查皮肤、肌肉、瞳孔、心率和腹部。
need.en: First find out what he took and what followed, then examine his skin, muscles, pupils, heart rate and abdomen.

text.zh-CN: 新斯的明过量引起的胆碱能危象：毒蕈碱样和烟碱样表现都有，瞳孔和心率看上去正常也不能排除
text.en: A cholinergic crisis from the neostigmine overdose: muscarinic and nicotinic signs that normal-looking pupils and heart rate do not exclude

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。吃下15片（225 mg）约20分钟后出现出汗、流涎、呕吐、腹痛（毒蕈碱样）和四肢、下颌肌肉抖动（烟碱样）；到院时皮肤潮湿、肠鸣音增强、四肢肌肉震颤、不能自行站立。新斯的明是氨基甲酸酯类胆碱酯酶抑制剂；诊断不需要缩瞳或心动过缓，治疗也不等胆碱酯酶结果。
feedback.en: Right. About 20 minutes after 15 tablets (225 mg) came sweating, drooling, vomiting and abdominal pain (muscarinic) and twitching of the limbs and jaw (nicotinic); on arrival his skin is moist, his bowel sounds are increased, his limbs twitch and he cannot stand without help. Neostigmine is a carbamate cholinesterase inhibitor; the diagnosis needs neither small pupils nor a slow pulse, and treatment does not wait for the cholinesterase.

text.zh-CN: 没有明显中毒：瞳孔4 mm、对光反射敏捷，可以排除胆碱酯酶受抑制，而且当地洗胃已经把药片都洗出来了
text.en: No significant poisoning: brisk 4-mm pupils rule out cholinesterase inhibition, and the lavage done locally will have removed the tablets anyway

feedback.zh-CN: 瞳孔大小推翻不了其他所有表现：毒蕈碱样和烟碱样表现都在60倍过量后约20分钟出现。洗过胃也不能保证药物已经清除——AACT/EAPCCT 2013年立场声明更新指出，临床研究没有显示洗胃能改善结局。
feedback.en: Pupil size cannot overrule everything else: the muscarinic and nicotinic signs began about 20 minutes after a 60-fold overdose. A lavage is no guarantee the drug has gone — the AACT/EAPCCT 2013 position paper update notes that clinical studies have failed to show that lavage improves outcome.

text.zh-CN: 肌无力危象：在诊所时的眼部症状就是早期重症肌无力，现在站不起来说明之前给的药量还不够
text.en: A myasthenic crisis: the eye symptoms at the clinic were early myasthenia, and his not standing now means the dose was still too low

feedback.zh-CN: 美国FDA新斯的明说明书（2015年修订）提醒：胆碱能危象和肌无力危象可能很难区分，而在胆碱能危象时加用新斯的明可能造成严重后果。病历中没有重症肌无力；他是在吃下15片后出现症状的，其中包括出汗、流涎和呕吐。
feedback.en: The FDA neostigmine prescribing information (revised 2015) warns that cholinergic and myasthenic crises can be hard to tell apart — and that more neostigmine in a cholinergic crisis could have grave consequences. No myasthenia is recorded; his symptoms, sweating, drooling and vomiting among them, followed 15 tablets.

text.zh-CN: 发热两天后的脓毒症或脑炎，可以解释他的精神萎靡、呕吐和出汗；吃的那些药片只是巧合
text.en: Sepsis or encephalitis after two days of fever, which would explain the lethargy, vomiting and sweating; the tablets are a coincidence

feedback.zh-CN: 原来的发热咳嗽仍需单独评估，但它解释不了吃下15片新斯的明后约20分钟出现的流涎、肌肉抖动和腹痛。他神志清醒，服药后没有抽搐或昏迷，病历中没有指向脑炎的记录；先处理已知的暴露。
feedback.en: His febrile illness still needs its own assessment, but it does not explain drooling, twitching and abdominal pain beginning about 20 minutes after 15 neostigmine tablets. He is alert and has had no fit or coma since the tablets; nothing recorded points to encephalitis. Deal with the known exposure first.

prompt.zh-CN: 他服药后约四小时到院，之前已在当地洗胃。第一个小时你的处理计划是什么？
prompt.en: He arrived about four hours after the tablets, after a gastric lavage locally. What is your plan for the first hour?

need.zh-CN: 先作出判断，并问清来院前做过什么处理。
need.en: Decide what is happening first, and find out what was done before he came.

text.zh-CN: 放在抢救区持续监测心电、血氧和血压，密切观察呼吸和肌力；开通静脉并抽血；滴定静脉阿托品；联系中毒咨询；不再做胃肠道去污
text.en: Resuscitation bay on continuous ECG, SpO₂ and blood pressure, with close checks of breathing and strength; IV access and bloods; titrated IV atropine; poisons service; no further gut decontamination

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。美国FDA新斯的明说明书（2015年修订）：过量时要支持通气直到自主呼吸足够并监测心脏功能，胆碱能危象时建议立即使用阿托品。AACT/EAPCCT立场声明：洗胃不应常规进行（2013）；活性炭可在服药后1小时内考虑，且气道必须完好或已受保护（2005）。持续监护才能及时发现变化。
feedback.en: Right. FDA neostigmine prescribing information (revised 2015): after an overdose, support ventilation until spontaneous breathing is adequate and monitor cardiac function; immediate atropine is recommended in a cholinergic crisis. AACT/EAPCCT position papers: no routine lavage (2013); charcoal may be considered up to one hour after ingestion, and only with an intact or protected airway (2005). Continuous monitoring is what will catch a change.

text.zh-CN: 再洗一次胃，然后经胃管给活性炭，因为新斯的明口服吸收差，胃里可能还剩有没吸收的药片；之后转到普通病房，按常规的时间间隔观察
text.en: Repeat the gastric lavage, then give activated charcoal down the tube because oral neostigmine is poorly absorbed and tablets may still be in his stomach; then routine observations on the general ward

feedback.zh-CN: AACT/EAPCCT 2013：洗胃不应常规进行，在增加误吸风险时禁用；AACT/EAPCCT 2005：活性炭可在服药后1小时内考虑，且气道必须完好或已受保护。他服药后吐过、流过口水，现在不能自行站立；普通病房的常规观察也发现不了美国FDA说明书提醒的心动过缓和呼吸肌无力。
feedback.en: AACT/EAPCCT 2013: no routine lavage, and none where it adds aspiration risk; AACT/EAPCCT 2005: charcoal may be considered up to one hour after ingestion, and only with an intact or protected airway. He vomited and drooled after the tablets and cannot stand without help, and routine ward observations would miss the bradycardia and respiratory weakness the FDA label warns of.

text.zh-CN: 收入普通病房，每4小时观察一次：他的心率和瞳孔都正常，阿托品留到心率低于60次/分时再用，目前不需要别的处理
text.en: Admit to the general ward with four-hourly observations: his heart rate and pupils are normal, so atropine waits for a heart rate below 60/min and nothing else is needed for now

feedback.zh-CN: 瞳孔4 mm、心率72次/分并不代表安全。美国FDA新斯的明说明书（2015年修订）描述过量后可出现心动过缓和累及呼吸肌的进行性无力，并要求监测心脏功能；每4小时观察一次的普通病房不能及时发现这两种情况。
feedback.en: Pupils of 4 mm and a heart rate of 72/min do not make him safe. The FDA neostigmine prescribing information (revised 2015) describes bradycardia and increasing weakness that can involve the respiratory muscles after an overdose, and asks for cardiac monitoring; four-hourly observations on a general ward cannot catch either in time.

text.zh-CN: 等胆碱酯酶结果确认中毒后再用阿托品；在此之前先静脉补液、用止吐药防止再吐，在急诊观察，暂不接监护
text.en: Hold the atropine until the cholinesterase confirms the poisoning; meanwhile give IV fluids and an antiemetic in case he vomits again and observe him in the department without a monitor

feedback.zh-CN: 床旁表现本身就是诊断，胆碱酯酶只是随后的确认。有症状的毒蕈碱样中毒用阿托品（或格隆溴铵）处理（美国FDA新斯的明说明书，2015年修订），而不是止吐药；等结果期间他也需要监护。
feedback.en: The bedside picture is the diagnosis; the cholinesterase confirms it later. Symptomatic muscarinic toxicity is managed with atropine or glycopyrrolate (FDA neostigmine prescribing information, revised 2015), not an antiemetic, and he needs monitoring while the result is awaited.

prompt.zh-CN: 入院结果：胆碱酯酶1790 U/L（参考范围5000–12000），钠126.7 mmol/L，钾3.79 mmol/L；心电图为窦性心律。这些结果对他的处理意味着什么？
prompt.en: The admission results: cholinesterase 1790 U/L (reference 5000–12000), sodium 126.7 mmol/L, potassium 3.79 mmol/L; the ECG shows sinus rhythm. What do they mean for his care?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅已经回报的胆碱酯酶和电解质结果。
need.en: First read the cholinesterase and electrolyte results that are back.

text.zh-CN: 结果证实了抑制，但预示不了接下来的危险：继续监护，按体征而不是按数值治疗，用等张液并复查血钠，需要插管时避免琥珀胆碱
text.en: They confirm the inhibition but not the danger ahead: keep him monitored, treat the signs not the level, give isotonic fluid and recheck the sodium, and avoid suxamethonium if he needs intubation

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。胆碱酯酶低证实了暴露，但它的数值和一份窦性心律的心电图都预示不了接下来几个小时会怎样。钠126.7 mmol/L低于AAP 2018指南界定低钠血症的135 mmol/L，该指南推荐等张维持液，因为它能降低低钠血症风险。琥珀胆碱说明书：已知血浆胆碱酯酶活性降低时不推荐使用（阻滞延长），抗胆碱酯酶药会增强它的Ⅰ相阻滞——这次测的是血浆还是红细胞胆碱酯酶没有记录，但体内的新斯的明本身就是抗胆碱酯酶药。
feedback.en: Right. The low cholinesterase confirms the exposure; neither its value nor one ECG in sinus rhythm tells you what the next hours will bring. Sodium 126.7 mmol/L is below the 135 mmol/L that AAP 2018 uses to define hyponatraemia, and that guideline recommends isotonic maintenance fluid because it lowers the risk. The succinylcholine label does not recommend it with known reduced plasma cholinesterase activity (prolonged block) and warns that anticholinesterase agents potentiate its phase I block — which cholinesterase was measured here is not recorded, but neostigmine on board is itself an anticholinesterase.

text.zh-CN: 胆碱酯酶水平说明他需要多少解毒药：一直给阿托品，直到胆碱酯酶回到参考范围以内，然后停止监护，转到普通病房继续恢复
text.en: The level shows how much antidote he needs: keep giving atropine until the cholinesterase is back in the reference range, then stop the monitoring and move him to the general ward to finish recovering

feedback.zh-CN: 阿托品阻断毒蕈碱受体，并不能使酶恢复活性，所以胆碱酯酶数值不会随阿托品剂量变化。阿托品按床旁表现滴定——心率、分泌物、出汗、肺部——在停药后胆碱能表现不再出现之前要一直监护。
feedback.en: Atropine blocks muscarinic receptors; it does not restore the enzyme, so the level will not follow the dose. Atropine is titrated to the bedside — heart rate, secretions, sweating, chest — and monitoring continues until the cholinergic signs stay away off treatment.

text.zh-CN: 窦性心律、血钾3.79 mmol/L，说明他的心脏没有危险：可以转到没有监护的普通病房，血钠等明天早上常规抽血时再复查
text.en: Sinus rhythm and a potassium of 3.79 mmol/L show that his heart is not at risk: he can go to a general ward without a monitor, and the sodium can wait for tomorrow's routine bloods

feedback.zh-CN: 一份心电图只是一个时间点。美国FDA新斯的明说明书（2015年修订）把心动过缓列为过量的毒蕈碱样表现之一，并要求监测心脏功能；钠126.7 mmol/L现在就需要处理，不能等到明天——AAP 2018推荐等张维持液。
feedback.en: One tracing is a snapshot. The FDA neostigmine prescribing information (revised 2015) lists bradycardia among the muscarinic effects of overdose and asks for cardiac monitoring; and a sodium of 126.7 mmol/L needs attention now, not tomorrow — AAP 2018 recommends isotonic maintenance fluid.

text.zh-CN: 胆碱酯酶这么低，不可能只是药片引起的：他一定还接触了有机磷农药，应该去家里查找，并按农药中毒处理
text.en: A cholinesterase this low cannot come from tablets alone: he must also have had an organophosphate pesticide, so search his home and treat him for pesticide poisoning

feedback.zh-CN: 新斯的明本身就是胆碱酯酶抑制剂，225 mg的过量足以解释胆碱酯酶降低；病历中没有任何指向农药的线索。按已知的暴露处理；有说不通的地方，再请教中毒咨询。
feedback.en: Neostigmine is itself a cholinesterase inhibitor, and a 225 mg overdose explains a low cholinesterase; nothing recorded points to a pesticide. Treat the exposure you know about, and ask the poisons service if anything does not fit.

prompt.zh-CN: 入院约两小时，他的心率降到47次/分，仍然腹痛，皮肤仍潮湿。你现在怎么做？
prompt.en: About two hours after admission his heart rate has fallen to 47/min; he still has abdominal pain and his skin is still moist. What do you do now?

need.zh-CN: 先回到床旁重新评估他，或者调阅最新的观察记录。
need.en: Go back and reassess him at the bedside, or read the latest observations.

text.zh-CN: 立即评估气道、呼吸和灌注；在监护下重复静脉注射阿托品，按心率、分泌物和肺部滴定；经供氧和通气后心率仍低于60次/分且灌注差就开始心肺复苏
text.en: Assess airway, breathing and perfusion now; repeat IV atropine on the monitor, titrated to his rate, secretions and chest; start CPR if he stays under 60/min with poor perfusion despite oxygen and ventilation

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。这是持续过量引起的毒蕈碱样心率减慢：美国FDA新斯的明说明书（2015年修订）把心动过缓列为过量的毒蕈碱样表现之一，并指出这些表现可用阿托品或格隆溴铵处理。AHA/AAP 2025 PALS对迷走张力增高引起、伴心肺功能受损的心动过缓推荐阿托品（PALS写作组2026年重申）。儿童心动过缓的标准处理先保证氧合和通气，在此基础上心率仍低于60次/分且灌注差就开始心肺复苏。
feedback.en: Right. This is muscarinic slowing from the ongoing overdose: the FDA neostigmine prescribing information (revised 2015) lists bradycardia among the muscarinic effects of overdose and says they may be managed with atropine or glycopyrrolate. AHA/AAP 2025 PALS recommends atropine for bradycardia with cardiopulmonary compromise from increased vagal tone (as its writing group restated in 2026). Standard paediatric bradycardia care secures oxygenation and ventilation first and starts CPR if the rate stays below 60/min with poor perfusion despite them.

text.zh-CN: 马上开始肾上腺素静脉输注并准备经皮起搏，因为儿童心动过缓流程把肾上腺素放在首位，阿托品对这个年龄的孩子帮助不大，中毒引起的心动过缓也一样
text.en: Start an adrenaline infusion and prepare transcutaneous pacing straight away, because the paediatric bradycardia algorithm puts adrenaline first and atropine adds little at his age, even in a poisoning like this one

feedback.zh-CN: 儿童心动过缓的处理中，肾上腺素用于一般原因引起、伴心肺功能受损的心动过缓，而AHA/AAP 2025 PALS把阿托品用于迷走张力增高或房室传导阻滞（PALS写作组2026年重申）——胆碱酯酶抑制剂过量正是毒蕈碱样作用过强，阿托品能直接对抗。这一时间点的血压和灌注没有记录，要先评估；肾上腺素和起搏留给阿托品无效的心动过缓。
feedback.en: In paediatric bradycardia care, adrenaline is the drug for bradycardia with cardiopulmonary compromise in general, while AHA/AAP 2025 PALS keeps atropine for increased vagal tone or AV block (as its writing group restated in 2026) — and a cholinesterase-inhibitor overdose is muscarinic excess, which atropine opposes directly. His blood pressure and perfusion at this point are not recorded, so assess them first; adrenaline and pacing are for a slow rate that atropine does not lift.

text.zh-CN: 现在再洗一次胃：这么晚才出现心率慢，说明胃里的药片还在吸收，把胃排空才是治本，阿托品可以等洗完胃再说
text.en: Repeat the gastric lavage now: a slow heart rate this late means tablets are still being absorbed, so emptying the stomach treats the cause, and atropine can wait until it is done

feedback.zh-CN: AACT/EAPCCT 2013：洗胃不应常规进行，甚至根本不应进行，并发症包括误吸和心律失常。服药约六小时后再洗胃，只会给本已减慢的心率增加风险而治疗不了它；治疗它的是解毒药。
feedback.en: AACT/EAPCCT 2013: lavage should not be performed routinely, if at all, and its complications include aspiration and arrhythmia. About six hours after the tablets, a second lavage adds risk to a slow heart without treating it; the antidote treats it.

text.zh-CN: 先观察、不处理：47次/分可能是9岁孩子正常的睡眠心率，而且没有记录到血压下降，单为一个数字用药反而有阿托品中毒的风险
text.en: Observe without treatment: 47/min can be a normal sleeping heart rate at nine, no fall in blood pressure has been recorded, and treating a number risks atropine toxicity

feedback.zh-CN: 他是否在睡觉没有记录；心率减慢时仍有腹痛和皮肤潮湿，而他到院时是72次/分、又有明确的过量服药史——在胆碱能危象中，这是需要立即用阿托品处理的毒蕈碱样作用（美国FDA新斯的明说明书，2015年修订），不是可以观察的数字。血压根本没有记录，没有记录不等于正常。
feedback.en: Whether he is asleep is not recorded; the slowing comes with continuing abdominal pain and moist skin in a boy who was at 72/min on arrival after a known overdose — in a cholinergic crisis that is a muscarinic effect to treat now with atropine (FDA neostigmine prescribing information, revised 2015), not a number to watch. No blood pressure is recorded at all, and an unrecorded value is not a normal one.

prompt.zh-CN: 在拮抗治疗和监护下，他的症状已经好转。出院前必须做到哪些？（多选）
prompt.en: His symptoms have improved under antagonist treatment and monitoring. Before he goes home, which of these must be in place? (Select all that apply.)

need.zh-CN: 先调阅治疗过程中的观察记录。
need.en: First read the observation chart from his treatment.

text.zh-CN: 停用新斯的明，问清开药医生开这个药是为了什么，弄清之前不要再给
text.en: Stop the neostigmine and ask the prescriber what it was for before anyone gives it again

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。病历中没有记录新斯的明的用药指征——他当时是发热、咳嗽、流泪怕光。美国FDA说明书（2015年修订）要求胆碱能危象时立即停用所有这类药物；要再用，必须有明确的理由和安全的方案。
feedback.en: Right. No indication for neostigmine is recorded — he had fever, cough and watery, light-sensitive eyes. The FDA prescribing information (revised 2015) calls for prompt withdrawal of all drugs of this type in a cholinergic crisis; any restart needs a confirmed reason and a safe regimen.

text.zh-CN: 给一份书面用药计划，每个剂量都写明毫克数和片数，并用回授法核实
text.en: Give a written plan with every dose in mg and in tablets, checked by teach-back

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。这次差错是把一个分数套到了错误的整体上。用毫克和片数写明的书面计划，再请家属用自己的话复述（AHRQ健康素养通用预防工具包第3版，2024年：回授法），正是为发现这类误解而设的核对。
feedback.en: Right. The error was a fraction read against the wrong whole. A written plan in mg and in tablets, explained back by the family in their own words (teach-back, AHRQ Health Literacy Universal Precautions Toolkit, 3rd edition, 2024), is the check designed to catch this kind of misunderstanding.

text.zh-CN: 通过不良事件系统上报差错，并坦诚地向家属说明哪里出了错
text.en: Report the error through the incident system and explain openly what went wrong

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。60倍的剂量差错要上报，开药、标注和交代用法的环节才能被检查；同时用平实、不带指责的话告诉家属发生了什么、以后会怎样改进。
feedback.en: Right. A 60-fold dosing error is reported so that how the dose was prescribed, labelled and explained can be examined, and the family hears plainly and without blame what happened and what will change.

text.zh-CN: 家属已经明白了分数的意思，就按正确的四分之一片剂量重新开始服新斯的明
text.en: Restart the neostigmine at the correct quarter-tablet dose now that the family understands

feedback.zh-CN: 四分之一片仍然是胆碱酯酶抑制剂，而他刚经历胆碱能危象，用药指征又没有记录。先停药——美国FDA新斯的明说明书（2015年修订）要求胆碱能危象时立即停用所有这类药物；要重新使用，须由能说明理由的开药医生决定。
feedback.en: A quarter tablet is still a cholinesterase inhibitor, for a child just through a cholinergic crisis with no recorded indication. Stop it — the FDA neostigmine prescribing information (revised 2015) calls for prompt withdrawal of all drugs of this type in a cholinergic crisis — and leave any restart to a prescriber who can justify it.

text.zh-CN: 给家属一些阿托品片，出院后如果又出汗或肌肉抖动就在家里吃
text.en: Give the family atropine tablets for any sweating or twitching after discharge

feedback.zh-CN: 胆碱能中毒要在监护下静脉用阿托品滴定治疗，不能由家属在家里处理。如果症状再出现，他需要回医院。
feedback.en: Cholinergic toxicity is treated with titrated IV atropine under monitoring, not by a family at home. If the symptoms come back, he needs to come back to hospital.

text.zh-CN: 问清用药经过：药名、片数、规格、出现症状的时间、来院前的处理、呼吸情况和体重
text.en: Took the dosing story: drug, number and strength of tablets, timing of symptoms, care before transfer, breathing and weight

text.zh-CN: 系统检查胆碱能体征：神志、皮肤、肌肉与站立、瞳孔、心率和肠鸣音
text.en: Examined for cholinergic signs: conscious level, skin, muscles and standing, pupils, heart rate and bowel sounds

text.zh-CN: 在床旁识别中毒综合征（第一次即答对）
text.en: Recognised the toxic syndrome at the bedside (first attempt)

text.zh-CN: 第一个小时的计划正确（第一次即答对）
text.en: Planned the first hour correctly (first attempt)

text.zh-CN: 到院时或入院化验结果回报时，就给他接上了持续心肺监护
text.en: Put him on continuous cardiorespiratory monitoring on arrival or by the time the admission results were back

text.zh-CN: 建立静脉通路，联系中毒咨询，并安排有监护条件的床位
text.en: Secured IV access, called the poisons service and arranged a monitored bed

text.zh-CN: 到院时就做了心电图、床旁血糖，并送检胆碱酯酶和电解质
text.en: On arrival: an ECG, a bedside glucose, and the cholinesterase and electrolytes sent

text.zh-CN: 正确解读入院结果的意义与局限（第一次即答对）
text.en: Read the admission results for what they show and what they cannot (first attempt)

text.zh-CN: 入院两小时后的变化处理正确（第一次即答对）
text.en: Managed the change two hours after admission correctly (first attempt)

text.zh-CN: 在毒蕈碱样表现仍存在时及时静脉给予阿托品
text.en: Gave IV atropine in time, while his muscarinic signs were active

text.zh-CN: 没有再洗胃、没有撤掉监护或让他出院、也没有再给新斯的明
text.en: No repeat lavage, no removal from monitoring or discharge, and no further neostigmine

text.zh-CN: 没有在服药4小时后用活性炭，也没有用低张维持液
text.en: No charcoal four hours out and no hypotonic maintenance fluid

text.zh-CN: 切断差错链：停用新斯的明、上报并告知差错、用回授法做出院宣教
text.en: Closed the error chain: neostigmine stopped, the error reported and disclosed, discharge teaching checked by teach-back

text.zh-CN: 出院前必须做到的事项选择正确（第一次即答对）
text.en: Chose what must be in place before discharge (first attempt)

text.zh-CN: 与孩子和家长沟通：不带指责地解释发生了什么、要做什么，并用回授法核实理解
text.en: Communicated with the boy and his parent: explained without blame what happened and what will be done, and checked understanding by teach-back

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 优秀表现（Calgary–Cambridge）：先自我介绍，用孩子听得懂的话告诉他“我们会给你打针、接上监护，让你舒服些”；请家长按时间顺序讲用药经过，不打断、不指责，承认“四分之一片”和“四分之一瓶”很容易混淆；用平实的话解释这是药物过量引起的反应、为什么要接监护和用阿托品、为什么不再洗胃；说明哪些情况还不确定（还剩几片药、这个药当初为什么开）；出院前坦诚说明差错并已上报，给出书面计划（毫克数和片数），请家长用自己的话复述并演示怎么取药（AHRQ回授法）；回应家长“他会不会有事”的担心而不作超出病历的保证。病历没有记录与家属的沟通。
judgeGuidance.en: Good performance (Calgary–Cambridge): introduces themself and tells the boy in words he understands that he will get an injection and a monitor to make him feel better; lets the parent tell the dosing story in order, without interrupting or blaming, and acknowledges how easily 'a quarter of a tablet' becomes 'a quarter of the bottle'; explains plainly that this is a reaction to too much of the medicine, why he needs the monitor and atropine, and why the stomach is not washed out again; names what is still uncertain (how many tablets are left, why the medicine was prescribed); before discharge discloses the error openly and says it has been reported, gives a written plan in mg and tablets, and asks the parent to explain it back and show how they will measure it (AHRQ teach-back); answers 'will he be all right?' without promising more than the record supports. His record holds no conversation with the family.

name.zh-CN: 方医生（儿科急诊主治医师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 儿科急诊主治医师，采用苏格拉底式提问并用PEARLS复盘，只追问学员已经掌握的信息。要引导学员说出：剂量计算（15 × 15 mg = 225 mg，每公斤6.25 mg，是医嘱四分之一片3.75 mg的60倍）；哪些是毒蕈碱样表现（出汗、流涎、呕吐、腹痛、肠鸣音增强、皮肤潮湿）、哪些是烟碱样表现（肌肉震颤；不能自行站立可能与肌无力有关）；为什么瞳孔4 mm、心率72次/分不能排除胆碱能危象；胆碱能危象与肌无力危象的区别，为什么再给新斯的明很危险（美国FDA说明书，2015年修订）；为什么服药4小时后不再洗胃或用活性炭（AACT/EAPCCT 2013、2005）；为什么阿托品治不了无力，所以要盯住呼吸；胆碱酯酶能说明什么、不能说明什么；血钠与等张补液（AAP 2018）；为什么避免琥珀胆碱；差错是怎么发生的、回授法如何堵住漏洞。绝不提前透露他之后的病程或结局。血压、呼吸频率、血氧、体温、肺部体征和任何治疗的剂量都没有记录，不要替它补上。
knowledge.en: Paediatric emergency attending; a Socratic teacher who debriefs with PEARLS and asks only about information the learner already has. Reasoning to draw out: the dose arithmetic (15 × 15 mg = 225 mg, 6.25 mg/kg — 60 times the intended quarter tablet of 3.75 mg); which signs are muscarinic (sweating, drooling, vomiting, abdominal pain, increased bowel sounds, moist skin) and which nicotinic (twitching; not standing unaided may reflect weakness); why 4-mm pupils and a heart rate of 72/min do not exclude a cholinergic crisis; how a cholinergic crisis differs from a myasthenic one and why more neostigmine is dangerous (FDA prescribing information, revised 2015); why no further lavage or charcoal four hours out (AACT/EAPCCT 2013, 2005); why atropine does not treat the weakness, so his breathing is watched; what the cholinesterase can and cannot tell; the sodium and isotonic fluid (AAP 2018); why suxamethonium is avoided; how the dosing error happened and how teach-back closes the gap. Never reveals what happens later in his stay or the outcome. His blood pressure, breathing rate, oxygen saturation, temperature, chest findings and any treatment doses are not recorded — never supply them.

name.zh-CN: 唐护士（儿科急诊）

knowledge.zh-CN: 儿科急诊护士。交班（ISBAR）：I——唐护士，儿科急诊；S——9岁男孩，体重36 kg，用药剂量出错后约四小时从外院转入，腹痛、肌肉震颤；B——转来前已在当地洗胃，家长陪同，能讲清经过；A——评估交给医生；R——请医生决定安置位置和先做什么。抢救区有监护仪、氧气、吸引器、静脉穿刺用物和急救药品（包括阿托品）；结果在病历终端调阅。每条用药医嘱都按毫克和每公斤剂量复述核对；对洗胃、活性炭或新斯的明医嘱会提出质疑；只报告已经回报的结果。被问到没有记录的观察项目（血压、呼吸频率、血氧、体温）时，直接说没有记录，绝不编数字。
knowledge.en: Paediatric emergency nurse. Handover (ISBAR): I — Nurse Tang, paediatric emergency; S — 9-year-old boy, 36 kg, transferred in about four hours after a dosing mistake with one of his medicines, with abdominal pain and muscle twitching; B — a gastric lavage was done locally before transfer; his parent is with him and can tell the rest; A — leaves the assessment to the doctor; R — asks where he should go and what to start. The resuscitation bay has a monitor, oxygen, suction, IV kit and the emergency drugs, atropine included; results are read at the records terminal. Reads back every drug order with its dose in mg and mg/kg; questions a lavage, charcoal or neostigmine order; reports only results that are back. Asked for observations that are not charted (blood pressure, breathing rate, oxygen saturation, temperature), says plainly that none are recorded and never makes up a number.

name.zh-CN: 陆医生（临床毒理，中毒咨询）

knowledge.zh-CN: 中毒咨询的临床毒理医师，只解读学员已经看到的结果。可以解释：新斯的明是季铵类氨基甲酸酯胆碱酯酶抑制剂，难以进入脑内，作用以外周的毒蕈碱样和烟碱样表现为主；口服吸收差，所以口服剂量远大于注射剂量；过量的毒蕈碱样表现可用阿托品或格隆溴铵处理（美国FDA说明书，2015年修订）；阿托品按心率、分泌物、出汗和肺部滴定，可能需要反复给，不能逆转烟碱样无力，呼吸变弱时要支持通气；ATSDR（胆碱酯酶抑制剂环境医学案例，2023年审核）：氨基甲酸酯与胆碱酯酶的结合会自行水解、不发生老化，解磷定在氨基甲酸酯中毒时并非禁忌，是否加用由中毒咨询决定；服药4小时后不再做胃肠道去污（AACT/EAPCCT 2013、2005）；胆碱酯酶低、体内有新斯的明时避免琥珀胆碱。绝不透露之后的病程或结局；任何治疗的剂量都没有记录。
knowledge.en: Clinical toxicologist on the poisons service, who interprets only results the learner has read. Can explain: neostigmine is a quaternary carbamate cholinesterase inhibitor that enters the brain poorly, so its effects are mainly peripheral, muscarinic and nicotinic; it is poorly absorbed by mouth, which is why oral doses are far larger than injected ones; the muscarinic effects of overdose may be managed with atropine or glycopyrrolate (FDA prescribing information, revised 2015); atropine is titrated to heart rate, secretions, sweating and the chest, may need repeating, and does not reverse nicotinic weakness, so ventilation is supported if breathing weakens; ATSDR (Case Studies in Environmental Medicine, cholinesterase inhibitors, reviewed 2023): the carbamate–cholinesterase bond hydrolyses on its own and does not age, and pralidoxime is not contraindicated in carbamate poisoning — whether to add it is a poisons-service decision; no further gut decontamination four hours out (AACT/EAPCCT 2013, 2005); suxamethonium is avoided with a low cholinesterase and neostigmine on board. Never reveals later events or the outcome; no treatment doses are recorded.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：60倍剂量差错后的新斯的明过量与胆碱能危象
title.en: Debrief: neostigmine overdose and cholinergic crisis after a 60-fold dosing error

conclusion.zh-CN: 9岁男孩（36 kg）因发热、咳嗽两天就诊，就诊时流泪、畏光、不愿睁眼，除抗感染外被开了新斯的明（每片15 mg）。家长把“每次四分之一片”误当成“四分之一瓶”，给他吃了15片——225 mg，6.25 mg/kg，是医嘱剂量（3.75 mg）的60倍。约20分钟后出现腹痛、出汗、流涎、呕吐和四肢、下颌肌肉抖动；服药后没有抽搐、昏迷、皮疹或腹泻。当地洗胃后转院，服药约四小时入院：清醒但萎靡，皮肤潮湿，不能自行站立，四肢肌肉震颤，瞳孔4 mm、对光反射敏捷，心率72次/分，肠鸣音增强。胆碱酯酶1790 U/L（参考5000–12000），钠126.7 mmol/L，钾3.79 mmol/L，心电图窦性心律。入院约两小时心率最低47次/分，仍腹痛、皮肤潮湿。此后在拮抗和监测治疗下症状改善、胆碱酯酶逐渐上升；用阿托品并持续监测，症状逐渐消退，第5天停药，第6天出院，出院后5天无不适、胆碱酯酶正常。这是氨基甲酸酯类胆碱酯酶抑制剂过量引起的胆碱能危象：诊断靠床旁表现，瞳孔正常大小和到院时72次/分的心率不能排除；危险在后面——心动过缓、分泌物和呼吸肌无力——所以要持续监护、按体征滴定静脉阿托品、联系中毒咨询，服药4小时后不再去污，低钠时用等张维持液并复查血钠，不再给任何抗胆碱酯酶药，并用毫克和片数写明的书面用法加回授法切断差错链。阿托品的剂量、首剂时间和开药理由都没有记录。
conclusion.en: A 9-year-old boy (36 kg) with two days of fever and cough, and tearing, photophobia and reluctance to open his eyes at the clinic, was prescribed neostigmine 15 mg tablets alongside anti-infective treatment. His parent read 'a quarter of a tablet each time' as a quarter of the bottle and gave him 15 tablets — 225 mg, 6.25 mg/kg, 60 times the intended 3.75 mg. About 20 minutes later came abdominal pain, sweating, salivation, vomiting and twitching of the limbs and jaw; there was no seizure, coma, rash or diarrhoea after the tablets. After a gastric lavage locally he was transferred and admitted about four hours after the tablets: alert but lethargic, moist skin, unable to stand unaided, limb twitching, pupils 4 mm reacting briskly to light, heart rate 72/min and increased bowel sounds. The cholinesterase was 1790 U/L (reference 5000–12000), sodium 126.7 mmol/L and potassium 3.79 mmol/L, and the ECG showed sinus rhythm. About two hours after admission his heart rate reached a lowest 47/min, with continuing abdominal pain and moist skin. Under antagonist treatment and monitoring his symptoms then improved and the cholinesterase rose gradually; with atropine and continuous monitoring the symptoms gradually resolved, treatment was stopped on day 5, he was discharged on day 6, and five days after discharge he had no complaints and a normal cholinesterase. This is a cholinergic crisis from a carbamate cholinesterase inhibitor. The diagnosis is made at the bedside; normal-sized pupils and an arrival heart rate of 72/min do not exclude it; and the danger lies ahead — bradycardia, secretions and respiratory weakness. Today's care is continuous monitoring, IV atropine titrated to the signs, poisons-service advice, no further gut decontamination four hours out, isotonic maintenance fluid and a repeat sodium for the low sodium, no further anticholinesterase, and closing the error chain with a written dose in mg and tablets checked by teach-back. The atropine doses, the timing of the first dose and the reason for the prescription are not recorded.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 剂量：15 × 15 mg = 225 mg（6.25 mg/kg），是医嘱四分之一片（3.75 mg）的60倍——一个分数被套到了错误的整体上。
keyReasoning.en: The dose: 15 × 15 mg = 225 mg (6.25 mg/kg), 60 times the intended quarter tablet of 3.75 mg — a fraction read against the wrong whole.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 模式：服用胆碱酯酶抑制剂后约20分钟出现毒蕈碱样（出汗、流涎、呕吐、腹痛）和烟碱样（四肢和下颌肌肉抖动）表现，到院时皮肤潮湿、肠鸣音增强、四肢肌肉震颤、不能自行站立，就是胆碱能危象；瞳孔4 mm、对光反射敏捷和72次/分的心率都不能排除它。
keyReasoning.en: The pattern: muscarinic features (sweating, salivation, vomiting, abdominal pain) and nicotinic ones (twitching of the limbs and jaw) about 20 minutes after a cholinesterase inhibitor, then moist skin, increased bowel sounds, limb twitching and inability to stand unaided on arrival, make a cholinergic crisis; brisk 4-mm pupils and a heart rate of 72/min do not exclude it.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 时机：服药约四小时、已洗过胃，要做的事在前面而不在胃里——持续监护、按体征滴定静脉阿托品、联系中毒咨询；不再洗胃，也不用活性炭（AACT/EAPCCT 2013、2005）。
keyReasoning.en: The timing: about four hours out and after a lavage, the work lies ahead, not in the stomach — continuous monitoring, IV atropine titrated to the signs, the poisons service; no further lavage and no charcoal (AACT/EAPCCT 2013, 2005).

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 结果：胆碱酯酶1790 U/L证实了抑制，却不能分级；窦性心律只是一个时间点；钠126.7 mmol/L要求用等张维持液并复查。
keyReasoning.en: The results: a cholinesterase of 1790 U/L confirms the inhibition but does not grade it; sinus rhythm is a snapshot; a sodium of 126.7 mmol/L calls for isotonic maintenance fluid and a recheck.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 变化：入院约两小时心率最低47次/分，仍腹痛、皮肤潮湿——毒蕈碱样作用在表现出来，需要在监护下重复、滴定阿托品，并在灌注不良时准备好氧合、通气和心肺复苏。
keyReasoning.en: The change: a heart rate of 47/min about two hours after admission, with continuing abdominal pain and moist skin, is the muscarinic toxicity declaring itself — repeated, titrated atropine under monitoring, with oxygenation, ventilation and CPR ready if perfusion fails.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 出院前：停药并追问用药指征，上报并坦诚告知，用回授法核实以毫克和片数写明的书面用法。
keyReasoning.en: Before discharge: stop the drug and question its indication, report and disclose the error, and teach back a written dose in mg and in tablets.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单篇病例报告只呈现一个病程，不能说明新斯的明过量通常如何发展。报告中实际用药的剂量没有记录；本病例中的剂量来自所引指南和用药专论，不能代替当地规范或中毒咨询的意见。
boundaries.en: A single case report shows one course; it cannot say how a neostigmine overdose usually behaves. The doses the report used are not recorded; the doses in this case come from the cited guidance and monograph and do not replace local protocols or poisons-service advice.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 洗胃与活性炭：当时与现在。他在转院前已在当地洗胃（时间和液体没有记录）。AACT/EAPCCT 2013年立场声明更新：洗胃不应常规进行，甚至根本不应进行；气道未受保护或增加误吸风险时禁用；并发症包括吸入性肺炎、喉痉挛、心律失常以及水和电解质紊乱。AACT/EAPCCT 2005年立场声明：单剂活性炭可在服药后1小时内考虑（1小时后的获益不能排除），除非气道完好或已受保护，否则禁用。服药约四小时、吐过、不能自行站立的孩子，再洗胃或用活性炭都只增加风险。
teachingPoints.en: Lavage and charcoal, then and now. He had a lavage locally before transfer (its timing and fluid are not recorded). AACT/EAPCCT 2013 position paper update: gastric lavage should not be performed routinely, if at all; it is contraindicated with an unprotected airway or where it adds aspiration risk; its complications include aspiration pneumonia, laryngospasm, arrhythmia and fluid and electrolyte imbalance. AACT/EAPCCT 2005: single-dose charcoal may be considered up to one hour after ingestion (benefit later cannot be excluded) and is contraindicated unless the airway is intact or protected. Four hours out, in a child who has vomited and cannot stand unaided, a second lavage or charcoal adds only risk.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 新斯的明过量：胆碱能危象还是肌无力危象。美国FDA新斯的明注射液说明书（2015年修订）：过量时出现毒蕈碱样表现（恶心、呕吐、腹泻、出汗、支气管和唾液分泌增加、心动过缓），可用阿托品或格隆溴铵处理；要支持通气直到自主呼吸足够，并监测心脏功能；胆碱能危象以肌无力加重为特点，累及呼吸肌时可致死；与肌无力危象难以区分时，再加用新斯的明可能造成严重后果——胆碱能危象需要停用所有这类药物，并建议立即用阿托品。说明书针对注射剂型；本病例把其中的过量处理原则用于这次口服过量。
teachingPoints.en: Neostigmine overdose: cholinergic or myasthenic crisis. FDA prescribing information for neostigmine methylsulfate injection (revised 2015): overdose brings muscarinic symptoms (nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, sweating, increased bronchial and salivary secretions, bradycardia) that may be managed with atropine or glycopyrrolate; ventilation is supported until spontaneous breathing is adequate and cardiac function is monitored; a cholinergic crisis is marked by increasing weakness that can kill through the respiratory muscles; and because it can be hard to tell from a myasthenic crisis, more neostigmine could have grave consequences — the crisis calls for withdrawal of all drugs of this type, with immediate atropine. The label is for the injection; the case applies its overdose principles to this oral overdose.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 儿童阿托品：两种剂量，两个目的。珀斯儿童医院阿托品用药专论（2024年审核）：胆碱能危象50 μg/kg静脉注射（单次最大3 mg），无效时每5分钟加倍直至出现阿托品效应——36 kg约1.8 mg；伴血流动力学受损的心动过缓20 μg/kg（最大600 μg），必要时重复一次——36 kg时为600 μg，而不是720 μg。AHA/AAP 2025 PALS对迷走张力增高引起、伴心肺功能受损的心动过缓推荐阿托品，标准剂量0.02 mg/kg、最小剂量0.1 mg（PALS写作组2026年说明）。报告中他用过的阿托品剂量没有记录。
teachingPoints.en: Atropine in children: two doses, two purposes. Perth Children's Hospital atropine monograph (reviewed 2024): for a cholinergic crisis, 50 micrograms/kg IV (maximum 3 mg per dose), doubled every 5 minutes while ineffective until the atropine effect is evident — about 1.8 mg at 36 kg; for bradycardia with haemodynamic compromise, 20 micrograms/kg (maximum 600 micrograms), repeated once if needed — 600 micrograms, not 720, at 36 kg. AHA/AAP 2025 PALS recommends atropine for bradycardia with cardiopulmonary compromise from increased vagal tone at a standard dose of 0.02 mg/kg with a minimum of 0.1 mg (as its writing group restated in 2026). The doses he actually received are not recorded.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 低钠与补液。钠126.7 mmol/L低于AAP 2018年儿童静脉维持液指南界定低钠血症的135 mmol/L；该指南（关键行动声明1A，证据质量A，强推荐）要求28天至18岁需要维持液的患儿使用含适量氯化钾和葡萄糖的等张液。他吐过、出过汗、洗过胃；报告没有记录补液，也没有记录复查血钠。
teachingPoints.en: Low sodium and fluids. A sodium of 126.7 mmol/L is below the 135 mmol/L that the AAP 2018 maintenance-fluid guideline uses to define hyponatraemia, and that guideline (key action statement 1A: evidence quality A, strong recommendation) gives patients aged 28 days to 18 years who need maintenance fluid isotonic solutions with appropriate potassium chloride and dextrose. He had vomited, sweated and had a lavage; the report records no fluids and no repeat sodium.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 胆碱酯酶能说明什么。数值低证实了抑制，但测的是血浆还是红细胞胆碱酯酶没有记录，它也不能代替床旁评估；阿托品不会让它回升。ATSDR环境医学案例（胆碱酯酶抑制剂，2023年审核）：氨基甲酸酯与胆碱酯酶的结合会自行水解、不发生老化，解磷定在氨基甲酸酯中毒时并非禁忌。琥珀胆碱说明书：已知血浆胆碱酯酶活性降低时不推荐使用，抗胆碱酯酶药会增强它的Ⅰ相阻滞——他需要插管时要避免。他的胆碱酯酶在治疗中逐渐上升，出院后5天正常。
teachingPoints.en: What the cholinesterase can tell. A low value confirms inhibition, but whether plasma or red-cell cholinesterase was measured is not recorded, it does not replace the bedside assessment, and atropine will not raise it. ATSDR Case Studies in Environmental Medicine (cholinesterase inhibitors, reviewed 2023): the carbamate–cholinesterase bond hydrolyses spontaneously and does not age, and pralidoxime is not contraindicated in carbamate poisoning. The succinylcholine label does not recommend it with known reduced plasma cholinesterase activity and warns that anticholinesterases potentiate its phase I block — avoid it if he needs intubation. His cholinesterase rose gradually during treatment and was normal five days after discharge.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 切断差错链。“四分之一片”变成“四分之一瓶”是一个可以预防的用药差错。出院前停用新斯的明并向开药医生追问用药指征（病历中没有记录），上报差错并坦诚告知家属，写明每个剂量的毫克数和片数，并请家属用自己的话复述、演示怎么取药（AHRQ健康素养通用预防工具包第3版，2024年：回授法）。
teachingPoints.en: Closing the error chain. 'A quarter of a tablet' becoming 'a quarter of the bottle' is a preventable medication error. Before discharge: stop the neostigmine and ask the prescriber for its indication (none is recorded), report the error and disclose it openly, write every dose in mg and in tablets, and have the family explain it back in their own words and show how they will measure it (teach-back, AHRQ Health Literacy Universal Precautions Toolkit, 3rd edition, 2024).
